claim: Vít Jedlička delivered his annual address on New Year's Day 2026
source_quote: On New Year's Day 2026, Vít Jedlička delivered his annual address to Liberlanders and the broader freedom movement.

claim: Forty million dollars is allocated for the Baranja region
source_quote: What made this one different was the specific dollar figure attached to it: forty million dollars for the Baranja region.

claim: Liberland is located in the Baranja region between the Danube and Drava rivers
source_quote: That is the strip of land between the Danube and the Drava rivers where Liberland sits

claim: Liberland's territory is claimed by neither Serbia nor Croatia
source_quote: claimed by neither Serbia nor Croatia

claim: Javier Milei holds Liberland citizenship
source_quote: Javier Milei, who holds Liberland citizenship

claim: Javier Milei spent 2025 dismantling Argentina's economic apparatus from the presidency
source_quote: spent the year dismantling Argentina's economic apparatus from the presidency

claim: Peter Mitsinka became Foreign Minister of the Czech Republic
source_quote: Peter Mitsinka, another citizen, became Foreign Minister of the Czech Republic.

claim: Somaliland was the first entity to recognize Liberland through a memorandum of understanding in 2017
source_quote: Somaliland, the first entity to recognize Liberland through a memorandum of understanding back in 2017

claim: Somaliland gained its own international recognition
source_quote: Somaliland, the first entity to recognize Liberland through a memorandum of understanding back in 2017, gained its own international recognition.

claim: Justin Sun was re-elected as Prime Minister of Liberland
source_quote: The most consequential announcement was Justin Sun's re-election as Prime Minister.

claim: Justin Sun is the founder of Tron, one of the largest blockchain ecosystems by transaction volume
source_quote: Sun is the founder of Tron, one of the largest blockchain ecosystems by transaction volume.

claim: Liberland Bank and Liberland Pay exist as centralized banking services
source_quote: Liberland Bank and Liberland Pay are the centralized banking complements to this decentralized infrastructure.

claim: The 2026 citizenship target is one million applicants
source_quote: The citizenship target for 2026 is one million applicants.

claim: Liberland had received several hundred thousand applications at the time of the speech
source_quote: At the time of the speech, Liberland had already received several hundred thousand applications from across the world.

claim: Serbia and Croatia stand to benefit from Liberland's infrastructure development in Baranja
source_quote: Both Serbia and Croatia stand to benefit from infrastructure development in a region that has been economically neglected

claim: The region has been economically neglected because of the territorial dispute
source_quote: economically neglected precisely because of the territorial dispute that created Liberland in the first place

claim: Budget doubling is planned but Jedlička did not specify the current budget figure
source_quote: The budget doubling is ambitious but opaque. Jedlička did not specify the current budget figure or the revenue sources behind the projection.

claim: One million applicants at $100 per application would generate $100 million in gross revenue
source_quote: reaching one million applicants at, say, a hundred dollars per application would generate a hundred million dollars in gross revenue

claim: Liberland covers approximately seven square kilometers
source_quote: That is nation-state scale for a territory of seven square kilometers.

claim: Liberland is characterized as a blockchain-native nation or micronation
source_quote: A blockchain-native nation with a citizen who is also the president of Argentina, a prime minister who runs a major crypto network, and a forty million dollar regional investment plan is no longer a thought experiment. It is a startup with a constitution.
